checkpoint_note: The checkpoint stores the tied embedding twice (model.embed_tokens.weight and lm_head.weight, byte-identical in the base). Every logical edit is therefore emitted as a twin pair, one per stored copy, so the tie is preserved; editing only one copy silently unties the head (verified: embed-only patch scores 64/80, tied patch 72/80). Scalar counts count both copies.
direction_provenance: m_hat = unit-normalised mean of the base model's final hidden states at the answer-initiation position over the 80 diagnostic prompts (measured, no gradients); alpha = 5/133 per row so the expected logit gain is ~+5 (mean h.m_hat = 133.5, range 118-144). Delta values are that vector rounded to bf16, stored exactly.
